title: legitimate exception: an explicit --no-build-cache is a deliberate choice (CodeQL, Infer, forced test runs), not reported

files..github/workflows/ci.yml:
name: CI
on:
  pull_request:
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: ./gradlew build --no-build-cache
